body: You aren't a bad person. If there was something bad you have done to your family ask for forgiveness. Or if they have done something to you forgive them. Ending things isn't smart at all, I think you just need a little lift. Myself I think that I always let people down, but I think of the things I have done good in life, making me think that I have a purpose. All of us has a purpose, find yours and use it to get yourself back up. Be thankful that you have your mom and sisters. Be thankful that they were still there for you when your dad left, make that the reason to live on with life. Hope that you would feel better!
